title: T24_1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Cells were cultured in RPMI-1640 medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) in a humidified atmosphere containing 5% CO2. Gemcitabine-resistant T24 cells (T24GR) were established in our laboratory. Briefly, T24 cells were initially cultured in the medium containing 5 nM gemcitabine and the dose was gradually increased over 3 months. Finally, we obtained T24GR cells that were viable in the presence of 50 nM gemcitabine. In specified experiments, cells were cultured in CSS obtained from Thermo Fisher Scientific (Waltham, MA, USA).
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated from cultured cells using the miRNeasy mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany).
label_protocol_ch1: Cyanine-3 (Cy3) labeled cRNA was prepared from 0.1 ug RNA using the One-Color Low Input Quick Amp Labeling kit (Agilent) according to the manufacturer's instructions, followed by RNAeasy column purification (QIAGEN, Valencia, CA).  Dye incorporation and cRNA yield were checked with the NanoDrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer.
hyb_protocol: The labeled cRNAs were purified, fragmented, and hybridized to microarrays in a rotating hybridization oven at 10 rpm for 17 h at 65 °C.
scan_protocol: After hybridization, the microarrays were washed according to the manufacturer’s protocol and scanned on an Agilent DNA Microarray Scanner G2505C with the Scan Control software (Agilent Technologies).
data_processing: The scanned images were analyzed with Feature Extraction Software 10.7 (Agilent) using default parameters (protocol GE1_107_Sep09 and Grid: 039494_D_F_20140813) to obtain background subtracted and spatially detrended Processed Signal intensities.  Features flagged in Feature Extraction as Feature Non-uniform outliers were excluded.
